instruction: Stand the yellow pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the yellow pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Choose a candidate that fits the gripper fingers, prefer highest score or valid grasp
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
chosen_candidate = valid_candidates[0] if valid_candidates else candidates[0]

res = grasp(chosen_candidate)
if res.get("holding_something", False):
    obs = observe()
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    table_z = obs["table_z"]
    holder_x, holder_y, holder_z = holder["center"]
    rim_height = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

    # To place a pen upright into a cup/holder:
    # 1. Carry the pen above the holder well above the rim
    safe_height = rim_height + 0.15
    carry_to(holder_x, holder_y, height=safe_height)

    # 2. Reorient the pen vertically.
    # The pen is held horizontally along the 'side' direction of the gripper (side = approach x finger_axis).
    # To orient the pen along the vertical z-axis ([0, 0, 1] or [0, 0, -1]),
    # we can tilt the gripper so that approach is horizontal, e.g. approach=[1, 0, 0] and finger_axis=[0, 1, 0]
    # then side = approach x finger_axis = [0, 0, 1] (vertical).
    # Check IK or position above holder
    approach = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    finger_axis = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
    target_z = table_z + rim_height + 0.08

    # Move gripper to position pen over the holder opening
    move_gripper(holder_x, holder_y, target_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

    # Lower slightly into the holder opening
    move_by(dz=-0.04)

    # Release the pen so it drops/stands in the holder
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
